name: @kickside/atlassian-ui
title: KickSide Atlassian Connect
description: Connect web component (kickside-atlassian-connect) for the Atlassian provider: OAuth (3LO) or stored-credential (Cloud API token / Server PAT). Mounted by the Connections picker via the provider's create_ui_id.

connection-saved.description: Emitted after a stored-credential connection is created.

oauth-result.description: Emitted after the OAuth popup completes.

wippy.description: Render the KickSide Atlassian Connect module-owned Wippy surface inside a host application. Load it by its registered custom-element tag, pass only the documented properties when selecting or editing a resource, and listen for its typed events when the host must navigate, refresh, or accept a value. The component uses the injected Wippy proxy for authenticated APIs and remains isolated inside its Shadow DOM.
